title: Developing a Trading Robot Has Been an Interesting Journey
author: Wide-Stand-8709
selftext:
I've been developing QuantumScalper 🤖 over the past few months, focusing on automation, strategy refinement, and performance testing.

It's been a challenging but rewarding project, and I'm interested in connecting with other traders and developers who enjoy algorithmic trading and building EAs.

If you'd like to follow the project's journey or join the discussion, I've shared the WhatsApp community link.

I'd also love to hear your thoughts:

- Have you ever built or used an Expert Advisor?
- What features do you think make a great trading robot?
